page: Microsoft Azure E64-16ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Edsv6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. The instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 32.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled, consisting of a 3780 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included.

Performance benchmarks show a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1792.38 and a multi-core score of 15111.56. The memory subsystem delivers a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1171.61 GB/sec, while uncached large block read and write speeds reach 100.42 GB/sec and 57.42 GB/sec, respectively. In database operations, the server achieves a PassMark database score of 8547.62 and handles 21.05 million Redis SET operations per second. For text and data processing, the single-threaded gzip compression speed is 28.73 GB/sec, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches 93.29 GB/sec.

The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations. These hardware accelerators contribute to an LLM inference speed of 1451.75 tokens/second for prompt processing on a small 135M model, and 107.84 tokens/second on a medium 7B model. Given the combination of 512.0 GB of RAM, a fast local NVMe SSD, and strong database performance, this server is designed for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and data-intensive enterprise applications.
